guide.note: A small bot roams the tools while the section is on screen and flies to the one the visitor hovers or tabs to, showing its description and the hint. Remove this block to turn it off (the plain hover tooltip comes back).

github.heading: GitHub activity
github.graphLabel: Daily GitHub contributions for the saved yearly snapshot

note: Items with an icon show as logos in their own colours; color is the brand colour used for the hover glow. mono: true is for single-colour logos, drawn in white. Items without an icon (or plain strings) show as text tags, for skills without a logo. href links each item to a page explaining it, and description is the one-sentence tooltip shown on hover and keyboard focus. Logos are saved in assets/icons/stack/ (sources and licences in CREDITS.txt there). The GitHub graph reads a saved snapshot, refreshed daily by .github/workflows/github-snapshot.yml (or by hand with: node scripts/update-github-snapshot.mjs). It shows one circular dot per day in week columns for the complete saved yearly snapshot.
